hbw_calder.accept_text:
He drills them in open ground where anyone can see, which is arrogance. He won't break and run, which isn't.

I'd rather fight one officer than the hundred farmers he's six months from making. That's the whole of my reasoning and I'd say it to his face.

The Hillsbrad Fields are south-east of this tower, in the middle of the valley. He will be on the drill ground.

hbw_militia.accept_text:
Ten of them, in the fields, and I want you to understand I've thought about this longer than it sounds.

They're farmers with billhooks and a grievance, and the grievance is fair - we are standing in their valley. But they've been measuring my gate for a month, and men who measure a gate are deciding something. I'd rather they decided it with ten fewer.

The Hillsbrad Fields, south-east of this tower. You will see the fences from the road.

tm_two_banks.accept_text:
Walk north from this gate, up to the market bridge in the Mill Yard, and look at both banks before you do anything else. That's the whole errand and it saves me a conversation later.

West side is the old village - inn, forge, chapel, the mill. East side is the Society and their vats. Three bridges join them. There is no fourth, the water is deep the whole way, and the wheel does not care who you were.

arw_through_the_wall.description:
Thoradin's Wall closes the south-east corner of Hillsbrad and it has been a closed thing for as long as anyone at Tarren Mill has been posted here. You can see the gap in it from the mill roof on a clear day.

It is open. Commander Thorne has had that confirmed twice and does not believe either of them, because what is on the far side of a wall nobody has crossed in three years is a question with no safe answer.
arw_through_the_wall.accept_text:
I am not sending a column through a gap I know nothing about. I am sending one person, and one person is you.

Get to the gap, get through it, and keep going until you find whoever is holding the other side. Then come back and tell me whether they are holding it against us.

The Wall is south-east of Tarren Mill, at the far end of the valley, past Durnholde and the ogres' stead.
